field_scopes.review/replay/replay.json baseline_contr: Exit status of the controller CLI process invoked by replay.py, not the wrapped dotnet process. The same definition applies to commands[*].returncode in each per-mutant attempt.json.
field_scopes.controller.json exit_code: Exit status of the wrapped child process, such as dotnet build or dotnet test.

semantics_sources.meaning: subprocess.run executes the controller CLI; returncode copies that process status.
The receipt stores the child's exit_code. The CLI can return 1 for incomplete execution evidence even when the child returned 2.

interpretation: Different process statuses are not disagreements in runner results. Original observed fields are preserved.
